acceptedAnswer.text: Concentrates are cannabis extracts with higher potency than flower.

The method of consuming concentrates varies depending on the product at hand. The prevalent method for concentrate consumption is “dabbing,” involving placing the product on a heated surface to produce inhalable, highly potent vapor. Dabbing devices, often referred to as rigs, resemble water pipes and consist of essential parts. The “nail,” serving as the bowl, heats the concentrate into inhalable smoke. The “dome” captures the smoke, which users breathe in through the main mouthpiece. Dab tools, small metal or glass pieces, handle the sticky concentrate.

children.html:
About Cannabis Concentrates

Cannabis concentrates, beloved in the cannabis community, go by various names and forms, such as sauce, slab, tincture, shatter, wax, and resin. What precisely are these sticky, high-potency globs that have made a significant impact on the cannabis world? The story of concentrates is a fascinating journey that has taken the cannabis community by storm.

Explore cannabis concentrates at Highway 90 Dispensary, including live resin, wax, badder, and other extract types. Concentrates offer a more potent cannabis experience and are popular among experienced consumers. Our selection focuses on quality, purity, and flavor.

What are Cannabis Concentrates

True to their name, concentrates epitomize the concentrated essence of cannabis. Various processes contribute to their creation, all centering around cannabis plant distillation to extract its most potent components. Concentrates offer users an immediate and intensified encounter with the plant’s finest qualities. With an average THC content ranging from 55-70% per gram, concentrates provide a potent and efficient method to embrace the full spectrum of cannabis effects.

The origins of Cannabis Concentrates

The history of concentrates is as intricate and fascinating as the product itself! Hashish, an ancient form of compressed cannabis trichomes, dates back thousands of years, originating in India, Persia, and China. Initially serving medicinal and spiritual purposes, it has a rich historical legacy. Hashish oil, extracted using butane and known as BHO (butane hash oil), reached the United States government in the 1950s and 60s. The CIA utilized it in biochemical interrogation methods, administering tobacco cigarettes laced with BHO to elicit a calming and disorienting effect during questioning.

Benefits of using Cannabis Concentrates

Harnessing the potency of concentrates translates to needing significantly less product for the desired effects, saving you time, energy, and money. Packed with high THC content, concentrates offer robust effects, making them ideal for users seeking immediate pain management or a pronounced psychoactive experience. Moreover, if smoking is not your preference, concentrates serve as the key ingredient in edibles and topicals.

Cannabis Concentrates FAQs

What are Cannabis Concentrates?

Concentrates are cannabis extracts with higher potency than flower.

How To Use Cannabis Concentrates?

The method of consuming concentrates varies depending on the product at hand. The prevalent method for concentrate consumption is “dabbing,” involving placing the product on a heated surface to produce inhalable, highly potent vapor. Dabbing devices, often referred to as rigs, resemble water pipes and consist of essential parts. The “nail,” serving as the bowl, heats the concentrate into inhalable smoke. The “dome” captures the smoke, which users breathe in through the main mouthpiece. Dab tools, small metal or glass pieces, handle the sticky concentrate.

What types of Cannabis Concentrates are out there?

Concentrates are beautifully diverse in nature and can be consumed in a variety of methods. There is a concentrate product for every user, making them incredibly versatile and accommodating. Depending on the experience you are seeking, as well as any symptoms you’d like alleviated, some methods may be a better fit than others.

  • Shatter: With its glass-like appearance and consistency, shatter is one of the cleanest forms of concentrates. You can tell by the light amber color that there are little impurities in the product.
  • Wax: Having a dense consistency, sometimes with a bit of graininess, wax is opaque with a deep golden color.
  • Dabs: Arguably the most popular method of consuming concentrates, dabs are ideal for a strong, fast-acting high. Most comparable to wax, but with a smoother consistency, and usually a little darker in color.
  • Edibles: Great for a delicious long-term, smoke-free, high potency expense. Check out our guide to edibles here.
  • Topicals: Best for spot treatments on specific areas of pain in the body, without experiencing psychoactive effects.

How are Cannabis Concentrates made?

Cannabis extraction, a meticulous process, demands professional expertise, a controlled laboratory environment, and adherence to safety protocols. There are three primary extraction methods:

  • Solvent-based Extraction: Professionals immerse the cannabis plant in an alcohol solvent, dissolving unwanted plant matter while extracting essential oils, cannabinoids, and terpenes. Concentrates like BHO, live resin, and terpene sauce are crafted through this method.
  • Solventless Extraction: Utilizing agitation instead of chemicals, solventless extraction involves high-pressure, low-heat machines breaking down trichomes to access cannabinoids and terpenes. This technique yields concentrates such as rosin, kief, and ice water hash.
  • CO2 Extraction: An eco-friendly and non-toxic approach, CO2 extraction employs heated CO2 in a condenser machine to separate the gas from trichomes. This method is recyclable for future extractions and is commonly employed in producing cannabis-infused beer, coffee, fruit extracts, and teas.

Do Cannabis Concentrates get you higher than flower?

Weed concentrates frequently deliver a more potent high compared to flower, thanks to their elevated potency. With significantly higher THC content than traditional flower, concentrates offer a powerful experience where a small amount goes a long way. The intensified and immediate effects make concentrates a popular choice among experienced enthusiasts and those seeking stronger, more profound effects. Elevate your cannabis experience with the heightened potency of weed concentrates.

What is the Live Rosin Cannabis Concentrate?

Live rosin stands out as a top-tier cannabis concentrate celebrated for its unparalleled quality and flavor profile. Employing a solventless extraction method, this process entails pressing freshly frozen cannabis flowers to extract the potent resin. The term “live” emphasizes the use of fresh, uncured cannabis plant material in the extraction, preserving the natural terpenes, cannabinoids, and flavors. The result is a remarkably aromatic and flavorful concentrate.

Are Concentrates recommended for beginners?

Concentrates are typically better suited for experienced consumers.

Do Concentrates require special equipment?

Some concentrates require dab rigs or compatible vaporizers. Ask your budtender about Highway 90’s selection of concentrate accessories.
